name: 💥 Prisoner Life
desc:
Welcome to Prison Breakout!  Be a Prisoner trying to escape the prison, be a Guard keeping the prison safe, or be a Criminal trying to raid the prison and free the prisoners. 🔫

⭐ Roblox PLUS Subscribers get access to a free supercar!

🔓 Break free and escape the prison!
👮 Become a cop and keep order with sirens, cuffs, and force!
🦹 Plan escapes, rob the armory!
🧠 Outsmart guards and other players in a high-stakes prison!

⚙️ Check the Settings Menu, you can customize gameplay features!
